title: account_objects
key_points: The account_objects method retrieves account object data for a given list of accounts.
It returns an array of objects, where each object represents an account object and contains information such as the account ID, ledger index, transaction index, and account type.
The returned objects also include details like creation date, flags, balance, and other relevant fields based on the account type.
This method supports pagination using the limit and start parameters to retrieve only a subset of the total account objects.
limitations: The information provided in this document is specific to the XRP Ledger and its public API methods.
It does not cover potential limitations or constraints that may arise when implementing or using these methods in real-world applications.
asserts: The account_objects method allows retrieving data for multiple accounts, including their object details like creation date, flags, balance, etc.
scope: This document describes the usage and functionality of the account_objects method within the XRP Ledger's public API.
